thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: High GPU queue growth in us-west-2. Autoscaler failing to provision. Avg queue length 1100 -> 2600 in 12m. error=QuotaExceeded | scale_attempts=3

sara_oncall: paging oncall. i'm looking. :wave:

ben_infra: I see the spike. autoscaler logs show API rate limited by cloud provider and GPU quota exhausted for account. provisioning requests stuck in PENDING.

maria_sre: what's the customer impact? any 5xxs or throttles surfaced to users?

ashley_prod: multiple customers reporting timeouts on generation and streaming delays. some realtime apps hitting client-side retries. Sales pinged me, they have a top-10 customer degraded (low latency SLA).

ryan_sales: can we route that customer's traffic elsewhere? they are in EU but routed to us-west-2 due to sticky routing + fallback policy.

ben_infra: aha that matches: routing table shows region preference set to us-west-2 for that customer because of pinning. stickiness TTL still active.

maria_sre: declare incident Sev2. creating a channel for mitigation. @sara_oncall you run the incident?

sara_oncall: taking lead. @ben_infra @maria_sre you are primary mitigators. tim_ops please prep support for manual pool adjustments.

tim_ops: on it. I can convert burst capacity to immediate for us-west-2 but that uses reserved headroom. want me to proceed?

sara_oncall: do it. we need immediate capacity. also prep cross-region spillover to eu-west-1 for non-pinned customers.

ben_infra: starting: `rhctl pool modify --region us-west-2 --burst-to-active true --force`

deploy-bot: Deploy started: pool modification job 0x7abf. Expected completion ~ 90s.

ben_infra: pool job completed. +34 GPUs moved to active. queue reduced from 2600 -> 1800 but still high. provisioning errors for more GPUs because account GPU quota is 0 left.

maria_sre: next: we should enable spillover routing to eu-west-1 for all non-pinned traffic and disable session stickiness temporarily for affected customers. commands?

ben_infra: `rwd-route update --from-region us-west-2 --spillover eu-west-1 --priority spillover` then `rwd-route set-sticky --customer all --enabled false --reason "incident 1778931123"`

ben_infra: applied. routing change propagated to edge in ~30s. monitoring...

incident-bot: ROUTING CHANGE: spillover to eu-west-1 enabled. Estimated shift: 22% of requests.

ashley_prod: confirmed top-10 customer's requests are still hitting us-west-2 due to long-lived pinned sessions. need to force-failover for that customer.

sara_oncall: advise ops to terminate pinned sessions for that customer with a short-maintenance notification. prepare message for them.

tim_ops: terminating sessions now for customer: cust-42-prod. `rwd-session terminate --customer cust-42-prod --reason "regional saturation"`

ben_infra: sessions terminated. I see traffic gradually shifting to eu-west-1 and queue dropping to 900. latency for routed requests in eu-west-1 is OK.

maria_sre: good. follow-up: reduce batch sizes for latency-sensitive customers to lower per-request GPU pressure. `model-config update --batch-size 8 --selector latency-sensitive`

ben_infra: applied batch size reduction. That shaved per-request GPU time. queue now ~480.

ashley_prod: customer-facing update drafted: "We're actively mitigating high load in one region; some requests may be routed to EU for better performance. You'll see brief reconnections as we failover sessions." waiting for approval.

ryan_sales: please send to cust-42 now. they were about to escalate. thanks.

maria_sre: alerting: autoscaler still failing for additional nodes due to cloud API rate limits. we should throttle non-critical background jobs (batch embeddings, offline evals) to free capacity.

ben_infra: throttling background queues: `queuectl set-rate --queue background-embeddings --rate 10/s`

incident-bot: QUEUE UPDATE: background-embeddings throttled -> expected delta -1200 queued tokens over 10m.

sara_oncall: monitoring for 10m window. if queue < 200 and error rate <= baseline, move to mitigated.

ben_infra: metrics: queue 180 -> 120 -> 95 over 12m. 5xxs down to baseline. Streaming latencies largely recovered for eu-west-1 routed traffic.

maria_sre: looks like containment. what's the root immediate cause? summarize for postmortem: quota exhausted + cloud API rate limit + sticky routing prevented automatic spillover. Also autoscaler hit its hard max because max_instances was set too low for us-west-2 for this tier.

sara_oncall: agreed. action items (quick):
- Increase max_instances for us-west-2 autoscaler from 128 -> 256 (ben)
- Request temporary quota raise with cloud provider (ben)
- Update routing policy docs to include emergency spillover path and lower stickiness TTL (maria)
- Add runbook step to evict pinned sessions after Xm of queue growth (tim)
- Postmortem owner: sara_oncall (due in 72h)

ben_infra: created cloud ticket #CLOUD-7781 for quota, started autoscaler config change, will coordinate with platform.

tim_ops: I'll draft the runbook change.

ashley_prod: sent customer note to cust-42 and top-20 affected customers. replies positive, some still monitoring.

sara_oncall: marking incident as mitigated at 1778934660. moving to recovery. final note: keep monitoring for 24h. please add any follow-ups to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1778931123

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated. severity=SEV2. timeline captured.

maria_sre: excellent work. postmortem checklist assigned. closing channel in 2h unless more activity. :tada:
